integration: Methods adapted to the existing stack; no upstream executable code or runtime dependencies copied.

repositories.name: vibe-audit
repositories.method: Masked security findings, dependency and server-boundary review, public security headers.
exclusions: Account access, recovery and delivery need separate observed evidence.

repositories.name: web-audit
repositories.method: Four-locale SEO, accessibility, responsive/browser checks and deployed HTML/assets.
exclusions: Legal references are not a legal certification; physical devices and mail delivery are separate checks.

repositories.name: claude.md
repositories.method: Scoped changes, independent review, real verification and explicit staging without force push.
exclusions: Reuse AGENTS.md and existing Flow instructions; do not install Claude hooks or model-specific rules.

repositories.name: mcp-diet
repositories.method: Discover only needed tools, batch independent reads and filter outputs using native orchestration and lean-ctx.
exclusions: Do not disable TLS verification or use --break-system-packages; no extra SDK is needed.

repositories.name: project-memory
repositories.method: Persist the profile trigger, one release procedure and dated evidence without competing memory stores.
exclusions: Reuse project instructions and reports; no unverified Windows hooks, credentials or personal data in memory.

repositories.name: bayes-gate
repositories.method: Distinguish observed facts from hypotheses, use falsifying checks and fail closed on missing required evidence.
exclusions: README claims MIT but no root LICENSE was found; adopt methods only, copy no engine code or approval hooks.

repositories.name: market-research
repositories.method: Attribute facts to dated sources and keep estimates, assumptions, unknowns and negative results explicit.
exclusions: No market crawler, paid API, advertising or outreach runs as a technical release step.
